card.text: Icy moon of Jupiter whose ocean may hold twice the water of Earth's oceans.

introduction.text: Dark, reddish-brown cracks cross Europa's ice shell. Its few craters suggest a young surface.

normal.title: Global image mosaic
normal.summary: Detail ranges from 200 m to 20 km per pixel, and shadows in the photographs remain.

galileo.title: Galileo regional photographs
galileo.summary: Controlled photographs reveal fractures, chaos terrains and craters. Original shadows remain; gray grid marks gaps.

sources.label: USGS · Galileo SSI
sources.locator: Processing; Accuracy, Errors, and Issues; General Usability

enhanced.title: SSI false-color mosaic
enhanced.summary: False color from 756, 559 and 404 nm bands over monochrome detail; areas without color stay gray.

elevation.title: Agenor Linea stereo terrain model
elevation.summary: Local stereo heights around Agenor Linea, near 142°E, 44°S, with detail of about 3 km. Heights are relative, not global.

geology.title: USGS global geology (2024 SIM 3513)
geology.summary: Interpreted plains, bands, chaos and crater units from the 2024 USGS map. Lines and point features are left out.

infrared.title: Galileo NIMS spectral color
infrared.summary: False color from 1.50, 1.34 and 0.73 µm NIMS bands: spectral differences, not natural color or mineral amounts.

ice-signature.title: SPHERE ice absorption
ice-signature.summary: Ice absorption in the measured 1.30000/1.50263 µm ratio. SPHERE, December 2014; roughly 150 km detail.

fine-ice.summary: Modeled 0.1–0.3 mm crystalline ice component, not total ice. SPHERE, December 2014; roughly 150 km detail.
